response.rationale: All options map to the same top-ranked leaf 'Frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (FTD/ALS)' with equivalent clinical identity and support scores. Option D is the most specific, including the genetic finding (TBK1-related), making it the best fit. Options B and C are equivalent in specificity, both referring to ALS-FTD/FTLD-MND. Option A is the least specific, referring only to FTD, which is a supertype of the more specific diagnoses presented in the other options and supported by the vignette.
